feature: Added the ML Kit Barcode plugin service with plugin ID `mlkit-barcode` and engine `mlkit-barcode`
Added host discovery and invocation through `org.autojs.plugin.MLKIT_BARCODE`
Added the `detect(imageFd, options)` barcode detection API based on image file descriptors
Added barcode format filters, maximum result limits, and the ML Kit `enableAllPotentialBarcodes` option
Returned `rawValue`, `displayValue`, `rawBytes`, format names, value type names, bounding boxes, corner points, and structured payload JSON

Added localized plugin metadata and usage instructions for Spanish, French, Russian, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, English, Simplified Chinese, Hong Kong Traditional Chinese, and Taiwan Traditional Chinese
Added ABI split APK builds for `arm64-v8a`, `armeabi-v7a`, `x86_64`, `x86`, and a `universal` APK
improvement: Kept Google ML Kit barcode scanning dependencies, native libraries, and model assets outside the AutoJs6 host APK
Release APK filenames include the version and ABI variant
